_meta.title: Kingshot Oasis Island Functional Structures and Buff Progression

coverage.scopeNote: This dataset covers functional/upgradable Oasis structures and the Skating Rink mentioned in the guide. Generic zero-buff cosmetic paths/vegetation are not exhaustively catalogued because the supplied document does not provide a complete cosmetic inventory. A separate cosmetic-assets dataset should be created if Forge needs every aesthetic object.

dataPolicy.attachmentValues: Preserved exactly unless explicitly identified as an interpretation (e.g., Construction Hut header -> Construction Speed).
dataPolicy.webResearch: Used to corroborate mechanics and surface contradictions; official Century Games help takes precedence over community guides.

knownConflicts.subject: Alliance help Water Essence amount
knownConflicts.attachmentClaim: ~300 per help / ~900 per day in one guide section
knownConflicts.officialFinding: Century Games says Fountain of Life level affects how much Water Essence caretakers get.
knownConflicts.resolution: Do not publish a fixed ~300/help figure as canonical. Describe help as variable/scaling unless a formula is later verified.

globalMechanics.decorationUpgradeRule: All decorations except Fountain of Life and Reservoir consume Lv. 1 copies as upgrade material (official).
globalMechanics.typeLimitRule: Only copies within a decoration’s Type Limit contribute bonuses and Prosperity; the highest-level copies are prioritized (official).
globalMechanics.allyHelpAmount: variable; Fountain of Life level affects caretaker Water Essence (official)
globalMechanics.recycleCaveats: Marketplace decorations can generally be retrieved when not placed; event/pack and mythic retrieval have special rules. See official Help Center for current restrictions.
globalMechanics.workerOnlineRule: Reservoir worker efficiency increases while the Oasis Island screen is being viewed.
globalMechanics.workerTargetingRule: Workers choose their own targets and begin with cacti near the Reservoir; reposition the Reservoir near desired cacti.
globalMechanics.postCactusState: Reservoirs become normal decorations; Purifier is awarded and produces Water Essence.

buildings.name: Fountain of Life
buildings.function: Central progression structure. Generates Water Essence, gates island progression and unlocks permanent account buffs.

notes: Century Games officially confirms Water Essence use, 12-hour storage cap, the Fountain Lv10 gate for Golden Sunset, and that Fountain level affects caretaker Water Essence. The exact level threshold/output table comes from the attached document and is corroborated by Kingshot Mastery.

buildings.name: Reservoir
aliases: Energy Accumulator (translation used by one source)
buildings.function: Houses workers who clear cacti and generate Water Essence while cacti remain.

knownEffects: Second worker unlocked; major clearing-speed milestone.
Maximum level cited by current community guide; exact level-by-level numerical output is not publicly disclosed.

notes: Century Games confirms Reservoir Type Limit 2, that upgrading Reservoirs clears cacti faster, offline collection continues, and exact numerical processing rules are not disclosed. Level 4 second-worker and level 10 max are from the attachment/current community guide.

buildings.name: Purifier
buildings.function: Produces Water Essence after all island cacti have been cleared, replacing the Reservoirs’ active cactus-clearing role.

notes: Century Games confirms Reservoirs become normal decorations after all cacti are cleared and the governor is rewarded with a Purifier that produces Water Essence.

buildings.name: Golden Sunset

unlock.initialBlueprintPurchase: Available in Oasis Island shop at Fountain level 10

upgradeMechanic.exchange: 10 General Wonder Blueprints -> 1 Golden Sunset Wonder Blueprint

buildings.function: End-game Oasis Wonder associated with troop Health and Lethality bonuses. Exact level-by-level stats are not published in the supplied source/official help.

notes: Unlock/upgrade/blueprint rules are officially verified. Community posts claim additional purchase cost and up to level 20, but these are deliberately not promoted to canonical values here without stronger verification.

buildings.name: Skating Rink
buildings.function: Economy-focused Oasis decoration associated with Research Speed.

notes: The attached 2026 guide and Kingshot Mastery both cite Skating Rink as +10% Research Speed at maximum, but the source document contains no dedicated level table and images.zip contains no matching art. Keep unpublished or visibly marked partial until the in-game tooltip/level table is captured.
